admission.justification: Losing uncommitted parked or owner-written bytes, or retiring their sole restoration authority after a misleading proof, is a plausible costly error; the named transaction witnesses check the obligation before such loss can be accepted.

applicability: Restoration of substantive tracked and untracked parked work onto an admitted carried code or memory head.
conditions: Proof enumerates the complete live recorded stash, including its untracked third parent.
The expected reapply is computable and every expected entry matches the worktree; already-held edits are restored.
An unreadable inventory is a failed proof, never acceptance from a capped sample.
exclusions: Non-computable entries fail restoration proof and retain cancellation authority.
Only memory-side root memory.md is disposable cache.

evidence: Synced freeze 231622b2c7e272e7ca182ec28d3da61ca1749e0f + tracked diff d4c93e6a94ef056ca4d5eb77d4c05d73eac6062654729e2cb979d0cfd870141f (S2 documentary correction of the S list: stale symbol spellings and the rule-1 inventory rationale corrected, all other producer fields identical); ResumedConvertedMemoryMergeTests (2 tests) in test_sync_parked_candidate.py.

statement: A sync's proof of restored parked work passes for an edit the carried line already holds and fails only when a parked byte is in neither the worktree nor the carried line, over every path the stash holds including entries beyond the journal sample.
